front-matter.title: Fix cache key collision on tenant switch

bug-ticket.problem: The cache key omits the tenant id, so tenant B reads tenant A's payload.
bug-ticket.expected-behaviour: Each tenant resolves its own payload.

steps-to-reproduce.step: Warm the cache as tenant A.
Request the same route as tenant B.

evidence.item: src/cache/key.ts:31 builds the key from route alone.

bug-ticket.direction: Prefix the key with the resolved tenant id.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Cross-tenant read returns tenant B's payload.
